result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would increase people’s capacity for empathy — not just feeling for others, but truly understanding perspectives different from their own.

Many of the world’s conflicts, inequalities, and cruelties come from a failure to see other people as fully real, complex, and deserving of dignity. If empathy were deeper and more widespread, I think many other problems — violence, exploitation, prejudice, neglect — would become easier to solve.
